title: A $164 Billion Fund Dumps These 3 Stocks
summary: Key TakeawaysGQG Partners, a firm that manages $164 billion, sold all of its Enbridge, TC Energy and Exelon shares in the third quarter, its latest 13F shows. Over the same quarter, it built NVIDIA and Taiwan Semiconductor into its second- and third-largest positions.
